_notes: plan: unified to «тариф» everywhere (student:v16/v17 and mobile:v3.home.noCounselor said «план»); «план» collides with «план обучения» (study plan) and «тариф» is already the term in marketing/common/agency ru files.

standard admission letter (표준입학허가서): rendered «стандартное приглашение на обучение» per the brief's official-name list, and plain «приглашение на обучение» where the English says only «admission letter». The 29 strings in other ru namespaces outside this job (student/mobile keys not in the job, success, visaroute) still say «письмо о зачислении» — owner to decide on a global rename.

Student-facing «консультант» replaced by «команда Hangyul / Hangyul Univ» (V22 team identity, matches the reviewed English); staff-facing agency/university strings keep «консультант» where the English says counselor.

Plurals: Russian `_other` is the CLDR fractional form (genitive singular, e.g. «1,5 сообщения») and was left as is; the `_few`/`_many` forms already in packages/i18n for existing families were checked and are correct. Every newly translated family carries `_one/_few/_many/_other`; count-neutral strings (e.g. «Срок сегодня · {{count}}») repeat the same text in all four forms. Strings with a count but no plural family (att.overSla, reviews.summary) were phrased count-neutrally («Ждут дольше {{hours}} ч: {{count}}»).
University app: «applicant» = «абитуриент» (already the term in ru/university.json), replacing «кандидат» in mobile:university.applicants.*.
conversation = «диалог» (was a mix of «переписка»/«диалог»); interview = «собеседование» (plan allowances said «интервью»); «Closes {{date}}» for application deadlines = «Приём до {{date}}».
mobile:v3.agency.waitingOn.* rendered as «Ход за …» (whose move it is) so student/university/us read naturally; view.* filters use «Ждут студента / университет / нас».
student:v17.gate.named: the {{what}} values are nominative noun phrases, so the frame is «В тариф входит: {{what}}.» (colon keeps nominative and lowercase valid).
student:onboarding.education.institutionPh keeps «Hanoi National University» untranslated (glossary: never invent a translated institution name).

Applier note: scripts/i18n/v32/apply-patch.mjs refuses the 58 new `_few`/`_many` forms as UNKNOWN KEY because the English bundle has no such keys (dry run: 459 applied, 58 refused). The ru runtime needs them (i18next does not fall back from a missing `_few` to `_other`), so they stay in this patch; the applier should accept extra CLDR forms when the English has `_other`, as the V28 validator did.
mobile:v3.home.stageLine.visa: «Оформляем студенческую визу» implied Hangyul issues the visa; now «Готовим документы на студенческую визу».
